mcq.q: What is the primary function of adding a parity bit to an ASCII code?

options.A: a) To compress the data and reduce storage space
options.B: b) To encrypt the data for secure transmission
options.C: c) To detect a single-bit error that may have occurred during transmission or storage
options.D: d) To correct any single-bit error that is detected

mcq.answer_text: c) To detect a single-bit error that may have occurred during transmission or storage
